notes: t011 thy is the verse's one added unit: יָד carries no suffix, and the parallel בְּרָגֶל is rendered with the feet, showing the ASV supplying determiners freely here.

A second competing reading for that thy, beyond the one the unit's note names, is rule 18's double-realization clause — thou ... thy both realizing the ךָ of מַחְאֲךָ, as מִכֶּם מָזוֹר → cure you of your wound. The added was kept because the coordinate רַקְעֲךָ בְּרָגֶל is written with the feet rather than thy feet, so the determiner tracks English supply and not the suffix.
The בְּ of בְּנֶפֶשׁ is what the ASV renders of, matching EZK.25.15.
The second infinitive's suffix is unrepresented: the ASV writes the subject thou once for the coordinated infinitives (rule 22).
